label: Mundra coal power plant opens (India)
note: First 800 MW unit of the 4,000 MW Tata Mundra plant entered service in March 2012.

label: Sasan coal power plant opens (India)
note: First 660 MW unit of the 3,960 MW Sasan plant started in 2013, next to large coal mines.

label: Navajo Generating Station closes (Arizona, USA)
note: The 2,250 MW coal plant, the largest in the western US, shut down in November 2019.

label: COVID-19 stay-at-home order (Los Angeles)
note: California's stay-at-home order began on 19 March 2020; traffic fell sharply for weeks.

label: No event: Burshtyn power plant area (Ukraine)
note: A control example: no known change in 2018, so the method should not report one.
